blends.desc:
# -[Telegram Battle Game - Click here](https://t.me/+18fu9HNb7qBmZWYx)

Blend 5 Magic Elemental Tokens to recieve a Evolution 4 Christmas Reindeer Sticker. 

Evolve your stickers to upgrade the mining ability and monthly MST. 

![](https://gateway.pinata.cloud/ipfs/QmeUkUPxZAwTazUL3zTHf7p7885sgovRrtzjkFXGLdd7GA)

Earn passive MST income by holding any of our four NFT collections.  

All NFTs in Little Monsters, Dust and Blood, Fantasy io and Monster Strike WAX collections are eligible for the Mercenary Art Studio Collector Points non-custodial staking program. Each month in addition to your qualified airdrops you will receive a number of Monster Tokens which can be kept in your WAX Wallet and used in our upcoming game Monster Clash, Air Drops, purchasing drops directly, upgrading your NFTs, LP rewards and more. 

- [Little Monsters Collection](https://wax.atomichub.io/explorer/collection/littlemonst1) 

- [Monster Strike](https://wax.atomichub.io/explorer/collection/mnsterstrike) 

- [Dust and Blood Collection](https://wax.atomichub.io/explorer/collection/dustandblood) 

- [Fantasy io Collection](https://wax.atomichub.io/explorer/collection/fantasyartio) 

For more info on our collections and collector point program: 
- [Collector Score](https://aw.eosusa.io/awbutler/mercartscore.html) 

- [Discord](https://discord.gg/P78gSryTGg)

- [Whitepaper](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1-XFJPUMw_jMBtXnG2FZoz3uUKDrl4nOARsyNK2RxAdE/edit?usp=sharing)

- [Twitch](https://www.twitch.tv/menacetec)
